mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above 3% annualized signals stronger household demand, which boosts corporate earnings and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when GDPC1 acceleration exceeds 3%, or Rank IC drops below 0.05 in such episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 6% signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressure and cost-push inflation, depressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when UNRATE < 6%, or Rank IC < 0.04 in such episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below 0% signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings expectations and equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when INDPRO < 0%, or Rank IC < 0.04 in such episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4% signals a tightening monetary policy stance, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when FEDFUNDS > 4%, or Rank IC < 0.04 in such episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) below -2% annualized signals weakening household demand, which reduces corporate earnings and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when GDPC1 < -2%, or Rank IC < 0.04 in such episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 8% signals a loosening labor market, which reduces wage pressure and inflation, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when UNRATE > 8%, or Rank IC < 0.03 in such episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in industrial production (INDPRO) above 4% annualized signals strengthening manufacturing activity, which increases earnings expectations and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when INDPRO > 4%, or Rank IC < 0.05 in such episodes.
